thread.title: Intel stock gains as Raymond James upgrades to market perform despite Apple concerns - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Intel stock gains as Raymond James upgrades to market perform despite Apple concerns - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Intel Corp. INTC, -2.89% are up 2.9% in premarket trading Monday after Raymond James analyst Chris Caso upgraded the stock to market perform from underperform. He points to a favorable supply/demand balance in the semiconductor industry. "While we still have long-term concerns, we don't see a near-term negative catalyst due to strengthening underlying business conditions," Caso wrote, adding that "an exception to the strong conditions is at Apple AAPL, -2.32% due to an unfavorable mix-shift for both existing products as well as for fall expectations." Caso also upgraded shares of Analog Devices Inc. ADI, -3.14% to outperform from market perform, writing that he sees the company's Apple headwind ending. Intel shares are up 40% over the past 12 months, while Analog Devices shares are down 1.5%. The S&P 500 Index SPX, -2.10% has gained 10% over the past year, compared with a 32% rise for the PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX, -3.29%
